source_evidence: Exact player 'Yes, but before then.. I’d like to open the vault and see if we can control the sentries' requests investigating the previously described vaulted chamber and possible control of gate sentries before camping or recruiting specialists. Clarify existing survey distinction: the 30x20ft western vestibule has apparently intact stone vaulted roof, NOT an established locked treasury/vault; archive's 8ft cellar void is not an established treasure vault. No invented sealed door, treasure chamber, keys, new command console or unprepared secret room. D342~19:35–20:05 party keeps V sword/Galepierce and other actual weapons safe in their own exterior custody; no armed crossing of gate. Mara and Cirren willingly conduct further non-destructive examination of accessible vestibule walls/recesses with Cirren's dagger temporarily entrusted to Fenar; they pass the existing gate openly unarmed. Fenar examines archive cellar from stable exterior breach edge (does not enter or load cracked unsupported floor), with V covering exterior and holding weapons. No visible sealed door/locking mechanism, accessible buried chamber or obvious control inscriptions discovered; further structural excavation needs qualified assessment. Cirren independently ritual casts prepared Detect Magic (10 minutes plus casting action, no slot; concentration up to10m) and makes a focused safe scan of guardians/accessible entrance masonry, with his ordinary Light on shield. The spell provides no detectable separate control object, accessible magical command interface or identifiable ongoing control spell; a construct's animation does not establish an ongoing spell and Detect Magic cannot read instructions or transfer command. No claimed specific spell school on construct, absolute absence of magic, universal immunity to control, hidden magic detector beyond range/material restrictions, or ability to automatically reprogram. Both sentries continue to accept the visibly unarmed visitor and maintain original programmed gate duty. Cirren does not touch them for Identify or attempt potentially hostile spell or command. He proposes asking Caul about their original creators and instructions and seeking an experienced construct-maker/arcane specialist to evaluate a safe method; no guarantee one exists, no new contact or hire. All party members reunite outside by cistern at~20:05; Cirren's dagger returned, all weapons in original custody (V sword and Galepierce, F greataxe/2 handaxes/4 javelins, C dagger), no gear loss or spend, Detect Magic concentration voluntarily ended after survey, C Light shield still active to~20:20. Two guardians remain HP52 each neutral and intact, no new roll, combat, damage, resource, rations, coin, ownership, camping/rest or onward travel. V next decision on camp or future investigation; no specialist costs or other offscreen results assumed.
